text:
Introduction
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I1, which 
must be carried out on a weekly bases as indicated in the above 
title block by W1. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 8 April 2002 for battery no. 1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, 
Cairo zone.
Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable ID safety category,
No smoking in battery room or any things leads to a fire
Using safety equipments, safety goggles, rubber gloves, safety shoes, and 
rubber apron is necessary
Environmental Precautions
Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Check terminals of battery
Clean the battery of dirt and dust
Clean the battery of any deposits of salt using warm 
water, rags and brush
Check ventilation system of battery room (must be 
checked daily)
Clean the floor of battery room by water
